title: Run Before Next
summary: Prove your code change before the video continues.
user: People learning programming from video lessons who need to prove they can alter and run the idea before continuing.
smallest_useful_product: A browser extension and tiny author manifest that pauses selected video timestamps, opens a prebuilt sandbox, and requires one test or output change before resume.
constraints: Only run allowlisted sandbox templates; do not scrape or redistribute video; obey host CSP and avoid storing learner source code by default.
